summary.text: Amanda López Askin is the Democratic nominee for Secretary of State and the Doña Ana County Clerk, an office she has held since 2018. She says her experience running 12 elections in the state's second most populous county qualifies her.

paragraphs.text: Appointed Doña Ana County Clerk by county commissioners two months before the 2018 midterms; won re-election in 2020 and 2024.
Holds a master's degree in marriage and family therapy and a Ph.D. in educational leadership from New Mexico State University.

sources.title: New Mexico Primary 2026: Secretary of State
